entities.name: Renée Taylor
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Renée Adorée Taylor is an American actress, screenwriter, playwright, producer and director. Taylor was nominated for an Academy Award for co-writing the screenplay for the film Lovers and Other Strangers (1970). She also played Sylvia Fine on the television sitcom The Nanny (1993–1999).

entities.summary: Renée Adorée Taylor is an American actress, screenwriter, playwright, producer and director.
